outcome: aberrantly expressed lncRNAs in terminal hindgut
aberrantly expressed mRNAs in terminal hindgut
cohort: Fetal rats with anorectal malformations (ARMs) induced by ethylenethiourea (ETU) and a control group of normal fetal rats.
finding: 164 lncRNAs (36 upregulated, 128 downregulated) and 772 mRNAs (350 upregulated, 422 downregulated) were aberrantly expressed in the terminal hindgut of ARM fetal rats compared to control fetal rats.
